node.statement: In the regime k,n >= 1, node 1.2.1 supplies the positive-unital (probability-row) hypotheses and node 1.2.2 supplies 0 <= epsilon < 1/2 together with ||MA-I_k||_{infinity->infinity} <= epsilon. All hypotheses of the exact external lem-prh are therefore met, so it yields a stochastic idempotent E:l-infinity(n)->l-infinity(n) satisfying ||AM-E||_{infinity->infinity} <= 2*sqrt(2*epsilon).
